link.note: His will names 'my father, James Tuthill'.

summary: Brother of Capt. John Tuttle (John's 7th-great-grand-uncle); his 1756 will proves James Sr. moved to Orange County.
bio: Will dated 17 Mar 1756, New Windsor, Ulster Co. (NY Wills V, Liber 20, p. 25): 'my father, James Tuthill, and Selah Strong, both of Orange County, executors'. Died young leaving five children.
sources: Abstracts of Wills, NYHS vol. V, Liber 20 p. 25, https://archive.org/details/abstractswillso04kellgoog
